description: This Java class provides utility methods for managing financial accounts within the OFBiz framework, including account code generation, balance calculations, and PIN validation.

classes.name: FinAccountHelper
classes.description: A utility class for financial account operations such as code generation, balance calculation, and PIN validation.

methods.name: getDecimals
methods.description: Returns the number of decimal places used for financial calculations.

methods.name: getRounding
methods.description: Returns the RoundingMode used for financial calculations.

methods.name: getZero
methods.description: Returns a BigDecimal representing zero with the configured scale and rounding.

methods.name: getGiftCertFinAccountTypeId
methods.description: Returns the account type ID for gift certificate accounts.

methods.name: addFirstEntryAmount
methods.description: Adds the amount from the first transaction in a list to an initial value, considering scale and rounding.

methods.name: getNewFinAccountCode
methods.description: Generates a unique random account code composed of uppercase letters and digits.

methods.name: getFinAccountFromCode
methods.description: Retrieves a financial account by its code, cleaning input to uppercase alphanumeric.

methods.name: getBalance
methods.description: Calculates the balance of a financial account based on deposit, adjustment, and withdrawal transactions up to a specified date.

methods.name: getAvailableBalance
methods.description: Calculates the available balance by subtracting authorized but unexpired amounts from the total balance.

methods.name: validateFinAccount
methods.description: Placeholder method for validating a financial account.

methods.name: validatePin
methods.description: Validates a PIN number against the stored account code.

methods.name: checkFinAccountNumber
methods.description: Validates a financial account number using the Luhn checksum.
